articles.title_en: Pro-War Blogger Vanishes From Public After Telegram Post About Oleshky Evacuation
articles.lead_en: Vladimir Romanov posted and then later deleted a message on his channel that said only four buses filled with residents from Oleshky had departed for Russia during the ceasefire, as opposed to 17 buses that carried evacuees to Ukrainian territory.

articles.title_en: Второй день ЧМ по пожарно-спасательному спорту принес РФ два серебра и бронзу
articles.lead_en: В первый день в подъеме по штурмовой лестнице на четвертый этаж учебной башни мужская сборная России заняла все три призовых места, а женщины завоевали золотую и бронзовую медали

articles.title_en: Russian strikes trigger emergency power outages in several Ukrainian regions, cutting water supply across Kyiv
articles.lead_en: One of Russia’s largest attacks on Ukraine’s energy system has been underway since the early hours of November 3, national power company Ukrenergo reported.
